title: Move HTTP handling to src/http and adopt structured logging
description: Refactor across 10 files under src/: request handling moves from src/server.ts to the new src/http/app.ts, console calls become the JSON logger in src/http/logger.ts, registerRoutes is renamed mountRoutes, and LOG_LEVEL is renamed PAYMENTS_LOG_LEVEL. Charge and refund handlers are untouched.

expected.summary: 3 of the 11 pages whose anchors match a changed file flag: Payments codebase tour (High), Payments local development setup (High), Payments API service overview (Medium). The other 8 had a 1-line logger swap in an anchored file and stay quiet.

pages.title: Payments codebase tour
pages.why: Glob src/** (normal) scores 0.38 on src/server.ts (+7/-30). Removed identifier registerRoutes adds 0.3, and the page's code block quotes the removed line registerRoutes(router, { config, pool }); for +0.4. Total 1.0.

pages.title: Payments local development setup
pages.why: Exact anchor src/config.ts (normal, +1/-1) scores 0.43. Removed identifier LOG_LEVEL adds 0.3, and the page's .env block quotes the removed .env.example line LOG_LEVEL=debug for +0.4. Total 1.0.

pages.title: Payments API service overview
pages.why: Glob src/** (normal) scores 0.38; its configuration table lists LOG_LEVEL, so +0.3 gives 0.68.

mustNotFlag: ADR-012: Idempotency keys for charge creation
expected.mustNotFlagWhy: Each has an exact normal anchor on a file that only swapped a console call for the logger (+2/-1, score 0.46) and mentions none of the removed identifiers. This is the broad-refactor precision check: a glob or file anchor alone is not enough, the page has to reference what changed.
expected.note: Scores near 0.46 assume normal weight 0.7 and net-removed identifiers (on '-' lines and not on '+' lines). If the matcher counts every '-' line token, the shared token payments-api pushes those 8 pages over 0.5.
